entries.title: Find units faster
entries.description: Search units by serial number, VIN, owner, product name, or model code. You can also filter completed builds separately from units that are still on hand.

entries.title: Browse long lists smoothly
entries.description: Lists now load more records incrementally, with more reliable results as you continue browsing.

entries.title: Filter products more easily
entries.description: Filter menus now stay within the screen, and products with only one variant no longer show unnecessary variant options.

entries.title: View product units on mobile
entries.description: Open the new Product Units tab to browse machines and view their serial number, VIN, product, owner, build state, jobs, and other details.

entries.title: Navigate lists more comfortably
entries.description: Product lists load incrementally, single-column cards use more of the screen, and search and sorting controls are clearer.

entries.title: Read statuses at a glance
entries.description: Build and quote status chips now display their intended colours, and cancelled unit jobs no longer also appear as in progress.
